name: Veðrfölnir Hawk
body:
VEÐRFÖLNIR HAWK
CR 4/MR 1

This bright-plumed raptor has piercing eyes that reveal considerable intelligence, but its cruel talons show it is also a capable hunter.

XP 1,200
NG Medium magical beast (mythic)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, piercing gaze; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +4 natural)
hp 36 (4d10+14)
Fort +5, Ref +7, Will +3
Defensive Abilities evasion; Immune fear

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 80 ft. (average)
Melee 2 claws +8 (1d8+4), bite +8 (1d6+4)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks mythic power (1/day, surge 1d6), twin talons

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 17, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 11
Base Atk +4; CMB +8; CMD 21
Feats Alertness, Eagle Eyes, B, Flyby Attack
Skills Fly +8, Perception +15, Sense Motive +4; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception
Languages Auran, Celestial, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Piercing Gaze (Ex)

A veðrfölnir gains Eagle Eyes as a bonus feat.

In addition, whenever it attacks a target with a miss chance due to concealment or total concealment it can roll twice and select the better result. In addition, a veðrfölnir can spend one use of its mythic power to ignore miss chances due to concealment or total concealment until the beginning of its next turn.

Twin Talons (Ex)

A veðrfölnir can attack with both claws as part of the same attack action, charge action, or standard action. If the veðrfölnir hits the same target with both claws, it can attempt a drag combat maneuver against its target as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If the maneuver succeeds, the veðrfölnir can move with its target after making its attack as far as the drag maneuver allows, even if its movement for the round would otherwise have been completed. The target is not grappled and is released at the end of the drag maneuver, which may result in a fall if dragged into the air or off of a wall, tree, or other high place. If both the veðrfölnir and the creature it dragged are willing, the dragged creature can hold on long enough to mount the veðrfölnir on its next turn as a move action and begin riding it.
